text: The headline DJ set was absolutely sensational and lights were incredible!
Waited over 50 minutes at the taco stand and missed half the opening act.
Loved the music and energy but the bar queue was a complete nightmare.
Sound bleed between Stage A and Stage B made acoustic sets impossible to enjoy.
Security personnel at entrance gate 3 were rude and unnecessarily aggressive.
Nine dollars for a small lukewarm bottle of water is sheer price gouging.
Medical tent crew responded in less than two minutes when someone fainted. Heroes!
Main lawn was clean and well kept with plenty of recycle bins everywhere.
The lineup schedule was posted on the festival app and gates opened at 1:00 PM.
Vegan food truck had delicious noodle bowls but portions were rather tiny for 18 dollars.
Sound was crystal clear at Main Stage; bass rattled my ribs in the best way.
Restroom lines took 40 minutes because half the portaloos had run out of water.
Overcrowding near the secondary tent felt dangerous with no crowd control barriers.
Information staff at the info booth were super helpful guiding us to lost and found.
Fantastic visual projections and lasers; although the volume was dangerously deafening.
Free filtered water refill stations were easy to locate and kept lines moving fast.
Merchandise tent completely ran out of medium hoodies by 4 PM on day one.
Shuttle bus service to the train station was prompt and saved us a long dark walk.
Mud near the outdoor dancefloor made walking hazardous after the brief afternoon rain.
The event was held at Riverfront Park with gates closing each evening at midnight.
Amazing saxophone solo and vibrant crowd vibes throughout the afternoon.
Paid extra for VIP viewing deck but security let general admission crowd flood the deck.
Pizza slices were stone cold and cost twelve pounds each. Total ripoff.
Stage lighting blew a fuse during the second set causing a 25 minute delay.
Volunteers handing out earplugs at the entrance were courteous and friendly.
Signs directing visitors to accessible viewing platforms were missing or broken.
Atmosphere was peaceful and family-friendly with nice chillout areas under trees.
Beer tent staff were fast and cheerful despite pouring rain.
Parking pass cost forty dollars which felt exorbitant for an unpaved farm field.
Sound mix on vocal mics was distorted and muffled during the indie rock showcase.
Great artisan cider selection though the dessert stalls sold out before sunset.
Ticket scanner at North Gate was broken causing hundreds of fans to queue in the sun.
Security checked bags thoroughly without creating long delays. Felt safe all night.
Wristband payment system crashed for an hour so vendors could not accept card payments.
The acoustic tent had wonderful intimacy and warm audio engineering.
